correctness.rationale: Exact Walsh spectrum and a three-sector pair-incidence decomposition prove the Fourier rank formula; tested modular ranks for all 45 cases d=4..9. Hilbert–Schmidt dissipation forces peripheral operators to commute with every rank-one dephasing projector; Johnson-graph H² connectivity makes the bright fixed algebra scalar while dark modes remain coherent. Contractivity and finite dimensionality give decay elsewhere. Permutation symmetry shows the origin dark projection is solely radial; Krawtchouk shell-zero equation (d−2k)²=d holds exactly in square dimensions, yielding two modes ±sqrt(d) of weight a=binom(d,(d−sqrt(d))/2)/2^d. Exact normalization gives the full formula. 116 integer radial identities and two direct finite Lindblad propagations passed, without being used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: Distance-two monitoring is a canonical full Hamming sphere, not an arbitrary slice. The exact if-and-only-if square-dimensional criterion creates a physically measurable nonzero-frequency coherence revival for an initialized corner, despite positive local dephasing, with O(d^-1) peak versus O(d^-3) stationary return off squares. The general asymptotic law applies to every initial density matrix and distinguishes dark states elsewhere from origin-supported dark states. The result goes beyond a rank table or trivial substitution.
